motivation: ENERGY-REPAIR-POWER-13 proved 84 uniformly distributed NEW observations required for one specified categorical reset rule. Test whether actively selecting interventions at a 24-observation total budget is genuinely more effective, not threshold tuning or replay of ENERGY-REMAP-11.
mechanism: Bounded causal-contradiction tournament: probe each state-action row once, then select the row with strongest positive reset/stay Bayes-factor contradiction, using only public outcomes.
hypothesis: At equal observations and identical fitted readout, a local tournament beats fully computed myopic Bayesian information gain, round robin and random selection on held Brier by >=0.010 overall and has nonnegative improvement in every scenario. It must detect >=80% changed rows, generate <=5% per-world NULL false alarms, and preserve old readouts under independent cold reload. Otherwise NO_GO.

worlds.common_random_stream: For each world, row and sample ordinal, every policy observes the same categorical consequence. OLD/held observations shared across policies. Source truth withheld from selectors.

policies.tournament: First cover every row once, then maximize positive log BF(reset/stay), stable tie by row index, add only 0.001/(1+new_count) exploration bonus.
policies.bayesian_information_gain: Choose row maximizing exact conditional mutual information between binary reset/stay and next outcome for same Dirichlet row model; stable tie by index.

shared_estimator: Every selector gets the same Bayesian Dirichlet(0.5) reset/stay posterior-predictive readout with prior reset=0.25; pooled OLD+NEW stay versus NEW-only reset, evidence-updated posterior odds. No source truth in fit; no extra observations for one arm.
source_law: Each of 12 action rows has an independent initial preferred category with 0.88 probability. NULL preserves all preferred categories; SINGLE_REWIRE switches one randomly selected row to a different category; OUT_FAMILY_DOUBLE switches two distinct randomly selected rows. Old 6 samples/row; fixed 24 interventions/arm; 96 held consequences per row, source truth only in score auditor.
oracle: True generative probabilities are a privileged score reference, never expected to be beaten.
measure: Paired held multiclass Brier overall/per scenario, changed-row P(reset)>=0.8 detection, per-world NULL any-row false alerts, action traces, exactly 24 observations per arm, old readouts before/after independent-process cold JSON reload. Report CPU/wall as exploratory all-in, not an efficiency PASS without matched full process qualification.
frozen_decision: NO_GO if <0.010 better Brier than best matched comparator overall, any scenario loses, detection <80%, NULL false-alert rate >5%, cold readout mismatch, source custody failure, or audit mismatch. Even positive synthetic result would be DEV_SIGNAL only; SCIENTIFIC_PASS requires independent owner source, repetition and model acceptance.
protocol: Prereg commit before source commit; GitHub source blob readback before any smoke; separate smoke from one 12-seed x 3-scenario primary; independent result audit without primary replay; never post-tune, reuse consumed seeds or alter prior 36-world primary.
isolation: Only additive files in existing draft PR #1346. No accepted main, Amalgam/native model, runner, scheduler, paid API, original source first-use, controller, merge, or deployment. Repo-only output, no chat artifacts.
